note: XG Drum Map. 'keys' maps MIDI note number -> drum-voice name as printed. 'inherits' lists the blank notes the PDF shades 'Same as Standard Kit' (base kit 127/0/1); every other blank note is shaded 'No sound' and is silent. The MSB126 SFX/Techno/Sakura/Latin kits have NO base kit -- all their blanks are 'No sound', so 'inherits' is empty for every one of them. C/M and TG300B drum data intentionally skipped.
